test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

She will clear the test tomorrow.

options.text: The test would be cleared by her tomorrow.
The test should be cleared by her the previous day.
The test must be cleared by her the coming day.
The test will be cleared by her the next day.

solution:
The correct answer is **'**The test will be cleared by her the next day'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the singular form of the verb will is correct.
 
• In the given sentence, the subject is '**she**' and the object is '**the test**'.
 
• In passive voice, the object comes first, followed by the form of '**be**' and the past participle of the main verb, and then the subject.
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence in the passive voice is: The test will be cleared by her the next day.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: ***The test will be cleared by her the next day***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Note that passive voice changes the focus of the sentence from the subject to the object.
 
• Passive voice is often used to highlight the action itself rather than the doer of the action.
 
• It is commonly used in formal and scientific writing to emphasize the action.
